sync_inline_model: sync task<T> runs inline in caller TaskId on the same thread; no independent TaskSpawn, TaskJoin, Future or worker assignment; rt cooperate retains the caller thread; an effect without a same-thread continuation proof is E_SYNC_TASK_SUSPEND even in a susp callable; do sync task accepts only an explicit void payload or inferred void, forbids return expressions, and MUST NOT canonicalize to do task; lexical using/defer unwind LIFO before return, cancel or fail
await_inline_future_model: await sync task<int> rejects E_AWAIT_TYPE (int is not Future); await sync task<Future<T>> joins the *returned* independent Future exactly once, without an artificial inline Future or changed scheduling
const_task_model: Local const requires compile-time-evaluable initializers; task, await, and sync task are runtime expressions even with constant literal returns. Runtime-immutable declarations use val; must not downgrade const silently
